title: MemoryProposalEvent
description: Memory v1: one candidate memory the Control Plane extracted from a successful composed run (GET /api/memory/proposals, memory.read). A proposal is never a write: only an operator's accept in Cockpit writes memory. Closed; idempotent on proposalId; stored proposals are immutable. Normative text: docs/contracts/memory-v1.md.

proposalId.description: "mp1_" + hex sha256 over JCS of {v: 1, sessionId, index, bodyDigest}.

seq.description: The plane's ingest order, strictly increasing, assigned once. The feed cursor.

model.description: The session's resolved model, or null when the harness did not report one.

name.description: Kebab-case slug; the memory file name without .md.

body.description: The memory text. At most 4096 UTF-8 bytes (checked by the reference validator).

target.description: A bundle the revision pinned, at the pinned digest; null when the agent named none or named one the revision did not pin.

supersedes.description: Member paths in the target bundle this proposal replaces. Sorted; empty when target is null.

items.description: A memory file relative to the bundle's memory/ directory: no leading slash, no '.' or '..' segment, no backslash or NUL, ending in .md. Cockpit v1 emits a single file name.

evidence.description: Counts only: no transcript, no file names.

outcome.description: v1 proposes only from runs that ended success.

at.description: The completion checkpoint's time, never the time of extraction.
